classification: post-event retrospective development with separate prospective commitments

hypotheses.primary: The same direct forecasting model trained with origin-safe archived electricity-distribution PPI features has lower seven-day quantile pinball than a freshly trained matched price-only model
hypotheses.secondary: Fine-tuning and evidence input effects are reported separately; no positive-result requirement

model.renderer_reason: Official supported non-thinking renderer; identical SFT and sampling template for bounded numeric JSON

data.series_selection: First two lexicographic exact headline daily-statistic series per approved source and GPU family, capped at 12; no performance-based selection
data.permission_rule: CC-BY-4.0 catalog sources restricted to approved hyperscaler spot and neocloud rate-card derivatives; marketplace asks excluded regardless of compilation license

sampling.reason: No fixed request seed; retain all actual stochastic samples, parsing failures and hashes

evaluation.selection: Lowest development 7-day mean USD quantile pinball; earliest update wins exact ties; checkpoint zero eligible
evaluation.eligible: Origin observation exists, at least 20 context observations, and all 1/3/7-day labels exist; locked before candidate evaluation
evaluation.uncertainty: Origin-level paired differences and range; three dependent retrospective origins are insufficient for population significance

gates.evidence: All registered monthly rows qualified; >=90% training-origin availability; >=3 distinct releases; exact reference series and captions verified
gates.rl: Separate unlaunched experiment; proper reward and verified credit assignment required

prospective.scope: New individual-contract transfer cohort, separate from competition medians
prospective.status: pending actual inputs and advance forecast commitments

evidence.availability: Original monthly government PDF vintage; actual8:30America/New_York release converted toUTC; first_observed_at remains current retrieval
evidence.news: Excluded: no origin-safe archived event feature table qualified
evidence.interpretation: PPI is not a datacenter electricity tariff; monthly global features do not identify a provider-specific energy-price mechanism

selection_data_note: Development origins select each arm/checkpoint independently by the same fixed rule. Previously opened retrospective dates remain descriptive, not an untouched test.
